# Junction Theme

<Agent>
Apply `junction` from the framework's matching theme package and pair it with `@farming-labs/theme/junction/css`. Verify dashed header, sidebar, and TOC rails; blue structural active states; full-width heading separators; and the top-right/bottom-left junction marks on technical surfaces.
Junction is available for Next.js, TanStack Start, Farm.js, SvelteKit, Astro, and Nuxt. If the factory does not resolve, use the matching framework theme package. If the structure is absent but colors load, verify the shared `/junction/css` import.
</Agent>

Junction is a light-first technical documentation preset influenced by engineering diagrams and the structured rail language used on [Jevia](https://jevia.dev). It uses dashed layout boundaries, compact Geist typography, square geometry, and a restrained blue signal color without copying another site's branding or content.

## Next.js, TanStack Start, and Farm.js

```tsx title="docs.config.ts"
import { defineDocs } from "@farming-labs/docs";
import { junction } from "@farming-labs/theme/junction";

export default defineDocs({
  entry: "docs",
  theme: junction(),
});
```

## SvelteKit

```ts title="src/lib/docs.config.ts"
import { defineDocs } from "@farming-labs/docs";
import { junction } from "@farming-labs/svelte-theme/junction";

export default defineDocs({
  entry: "docs",
  theme: junction(),
});
```

Astro uses `@farming-labs/astro-theme/junction`, and Nuxt uses `@farming-labs/nuxt-theme/junction`.

Import the shared visual layer for every framework:

```css title="global.css"
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@farming-labs/theme/junction/css";
```

## Defaults

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Primary | `#0057ff` |
| Background | `#fbfbf8` light, `#090909` dark |
| Border radius | `0.125rem` |
| Content width | 840px |
| Sidebar width | 248px |
| TOC width | 224px |
| Header height | 56px |

## Design Language

- Dashed header, sidebar, TOC, and section rails establish the page structure.
- Small square marks identify visual junctions without wrapping every section in a card.
- Mono typography is reserved for navigation, controls, tables, and technical metadata.
- Code panels stay near-black in both color modes for predictable contrast.
- Active navigation uses a blue structural rail instead of a large filled pill.
- Reduced-motion preferences disable nonessential transitions and animation.

## Customizing

```tsx title="docs.config.ts"
theme: junction({
  ui: {
    colors: { primary: "#7c3aed" },
    layout: { contentWidth: 900, sidebarWidth: 264 },
  },
}),
```

Keep the accent saturated enough to remain visible against both the light canvas and the dark navigation surfaces.
